fields.Name: T310 - Scheduling Dashboard Overview
fields.Description: Exercises the bespoke SchedulingOverviewComponent (health-ring SVG, KPI cards, alerts/locks/upcoming panels) — not the generic entity grid or any generic dashboard shell.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box) and switch to the 'Scheduling' application. Land on its 'Dashboard' left-nav section (the default). Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. Success is seeing the scheduling overview render: a System Health area (a circular health-score ring) plus KPI cards such as 'Active Jobs', 'Due Next Hour', 'Runs (24h)' and 'Running Now', and side panels titled 'Live Executions', 'Alerts'/'All Clear', and 'Upcoming (24h)'. Empty panels showing a 'No recent executions' / 'No active alerts' state still count as success — you do NOT need any populated data.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Scheduling application opens and the Dashboard section shows a System Health ring and KPI cards (Active Jobs / Due Next Hour / Runs / Running Now)
The Live Executions, Alerts (or 'All Clear'), and Upcoming panels render — populated rows or a valid empty-state message are both acceptable
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
